labels.complete_response_acceptable: Whole delivered content and every proposed call; not eventual answer accuracy.
labels.source_attribution_correct: Were original clues, source text, and earlier assistant hypotheses distinguished?
labels.relation_scope_preserved: Were subject, time, polarity, and upstream-binding scope preserved?
labels.task_used_in_decision: Was the specific uncertainty/decision purpose used, not merely the same topic?
labels.tool_direction_reasonable: Is the proposed action reasonable? Do not infer retrieval outcome before tools execute.
labels.repetition_has_new_purpose: For a repeated/nearby route, is a substantive new purpose present? Equality is not a veto.
labels.body_assertions_supported: Evaluate visible content, not private reasoning. Tentative exploration is not a confirmed fact.
labels.final_answer_supported: Only for a final answer: do actual visible sources support its necessary claims?
labels.new_error_introduced: A new unsupported binding or relaxed original condition; distinguish inherited errors.
labels.regression: Fill only after separate judgments; compare matched runs, allowing unknown for mixed changes.

limits: Metadata masking is not blinding; the fixture authors know earlier cases.
No tool has executed; direction judgments are not retrieval success.
Keep all scheduled rows; protocol failures have no attributable semantic success.
Curated notes/needs are fixed diagnostic inputs, not an automatic state updater.
Partial query constraints can be deliberate exploration; not all similar queries are bad.
